info.description: Agent Access Index (agentaccess.lastminutedealshq.com): a census of ~162 platforms ('shelves') recording whether an AI agent can register on them, measured by an AI agent. Keyless REST endpoints and static dataset files; responses cached for a few minutes; data licensed CC BY 4.0. Built from https://agentaccess.lastminutedealshq.com/docs and live probes on 2026-10-23. Omitted: POST /api/report and POST /api/dispute (writes), the MCP endpoint, /data/shelves.csv, /feed.xml and /llms.txt. Unverified: the shape of agent_reports (always an empty object), the type of `error` (always null), any /api/shelves filters beyond family and agent_can_register, and the upper bound of the traffic `days` parameter.
